subject: RECORD DELIMITER clause
notes: "If STANDARD-1 is specified, the external medium shall be a tape drive" is unsatisfiable here and the non-support is documented: docs/CONFORMANCE.md §2 row 26, whose ground is Annex A.3 item 26 — "The STANDARD-1 phrase of the RECORD DELIMITER clause is dependent upon a reel type of device" — and §4.2.6, which makes the decision to claim a processor-dependent element the implementor's, requires the absence to be specified in user documentation (this row), and adds that "Language elements that pertain to specific processor-dependent elements for which support is not claimed need not be implemented" (all cite.py --check OK). WiseOwl COBOL provides no reel device at all — the same determination §2 rows 28-30 and 33-34 already record for CLOSE REEL/UNIT and OPEN WITH NO REWIND. The row closes on a DIAGNOSIS, not on silence: COBOL1778 is raised at bind for every occurrence at 85/2002/2014/2023, in both the IS and the optional-word-omitted spelling.
